## Gap ID
EXT-012 / GAP-003 (related)

## Source
gap-analysis-byos-extensibility, gap-analysis-feature-parity

## Description
OSimFlow has no measure management system. Users must manually bundle measures into `template_sim_package`. There is no:
- Measure discovery API
- Measure argument introspection
- Measure version management
- BCL (Building Component Library) integration

openstudio-server has full measure management via PAT.

## Evidence
- `osimflow/work.py` — measures loaded from template package only
- No `MeasureRegistry` class
- No measure argument parser

## Severity
Critical

## Recommended Mitigation
Build a minimal `MeasureRegistry` class that:
1. Indexes `measures/` subdirectories from `template_sim_package`
2. Reads `measure.rb`/`measure.py` argument definitions
3. Validates `variables.yml` mappings at analysis time

## Labels
gap-analysis, measures, extensibility, critical
